title: India plans first tokenized bonds using wholesale CBDC
dek: India's state-controlled REC will issue tokenized corporate bonds in September using blockchain settlement and wholesale digital rupee payments. The pilot marks sovereign adoption of tokenization for capital markets infrastructure.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: REC to issue tokenized corporate bonds in September using wholesale CBDC for settlement with select investors.
bottom_line: Watch for the September issuance to complete and for India to publish pilot metrics on settlement speed, cost, or institutional adoption. If the debt sells and settles without material delays, expect announcements of a broader rollout; failure or delays would signal technical or regulatory hurdles to tokenized sovereign debt markets.
body:
India's state-controlled Renewable Energy Corporation will issue its first tokenized corporate bonds in September, settling transactions using blockchain-based technology and wholesale digital rupee payments to select investors.
The issuance represents a shift from central bank digital currency research into live debt markets infrastructure. According to Cointelegraph, investors in the pilot will use wholesale CBDC to complete purchases, anchoring the bond settlement to India's sovereign digital rupee.
The wholesale CBDC used in settlement is distinct from retail central bank digital currencies; it operates between financial institutions and settles high-value transactions on permissioned blockchain networks.
Cointelegraph reports the September launch will involve select institutional investors, though details on participant count, issuance size, or the specific blockchain platform remain unreported.
